description: This file implements WebSocket frame handling, including frame header size calculation, header writing, masking key generation, and payload masking functions within the 'net' namespace.

classes.name: WebSocketFrameHeader
classes.description: Represents the header of a WebSocket frame, including methods for cloning and copying header data.

classes.name: WebSocketFrame
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket frame, constructed with a specific opcode.

classes.name: WebSocketFrameChunk
classes.description: Represents a chunk of a WebSocket frame.

classes.name: WebSocketMaskingKey
classes.description: Contains the masking key used for payload masking in WebSocket frames.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the WebSocketFrameHeader.

methods.name: CopyFrom
methods.description: Copies header data from another WebSocketFrameHeader instance.

methods.name: GetWebSocketFrameHeaderSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of a WebSocket frame header based on its payload length and masking.

methods.name: WriteWebSocketFrameHeader
methods.description: Serializes a WebSocket frame header into a buffer, including extended length and masking key if applicable.

methods.name: GenerateWebSocketMaskingKey
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure masking key for WebSocket frames.

methods.name: MaskWebSocketFramePayload
methods.description: Applies or removes masking on the payload data using the masking key, optimized with vectorized operations.
